description: Reconstruction of the peculiar Type II event SN 1987A.
disclaimer: Semi-analytic reconstruction constrained by observations, not a radiation-hydrodynamic fit.

historical_metadata.name: SN 1987A
historical_metadata.historical_source_or_remnant: Sanduleak -69 202; resolved remnant and equatorial ring
historical_metadata.uncertainty_level: low for distance and peak V; model-dependent for progenitor/explosion

source_notes: AAVSO visual light curve: V maximum about 2.9 near day 80.
Panagia et al. geometric ring distance: 51.4±1.2 kpc.
Utrobin 2005 and Menon et al. 2019 motivate the explosion calibration.
